categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two main business segments: (1) Smart Monitoring Business - producing sensing layer hardware devices and environmental monitoring systems including water quality, air quality, noise, and ecological monitoring instruments and platforms; (2) Public Safety Big Data Business - developing mobile network data collection and analysis systems for public security applications. Additionally, the company is expanding into digital agriculture, smart water management, digital ocean monitoring, and smart city operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies are based on precision instrument techniques including spectrophotometry, electrochemistry, mass spectrometry, chromatography, and optical methods. Products utilize IoT architecture integrating sensing layer, network layer, and application layer technologies. Key technical platforms include light absorption methods, distillation methods, electrode methods, titration methods, voltammetry methods, and light scattering methods. Manufacturing combines standardized batch production with customized non-standard product development.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are government departments, public institutions, and enterprises requiring data services and intelligent monitoring solutions. Key end markets include ecological environment protection, water resources management, agriculture, ocean monitoring, disaster prevention, urban operations, and public safety. The company serves customers across multiple provinces in China with a focus on environmental monitoring and water management sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationally across China with major presence in Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest regions. Service coverage extends to most provinces. The company has established regional operational headquarters in southern and northern China to better serve regional markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates at the sensing layer and application layer of the IoT value chain, producing intelligent sensing equipment and big data analysis platforms. It engages in both upstream component sourcing and downstream system integration and service delivery, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider rather than a single-point supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) advancing smart environmental monitoring with AI integration for image recognition and voice identification; (2) expanding into smart water management, digital agriculture, digital ocean monitoring, and smart city operations; (3) continuous R&D investment in sensing layer hardware and big data software platforms; (4) incorporating emerging technologies like artificial intelligence, remote sensing, and digital twins; (5) improving product miniaturization, integration, and intelligence levels.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through two primary models: (1) Product sales - manufacturing and selling sensing layer instruments, monitoring systems, and big data software platforms; (2) Service revenue - providing environmental monitoring operational services including remote inspection, equipment maintenance, quality control, data analysis, environmental warning, and pollution tracing. Revenue is recognized upon project completion and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Main competitors include international companies (Hach, Thermo Fisher), domestic listed companies (Ligand Technology, Juguang Technology, Anhui Yiyi), and numerous small-to-medium enterprises. The company positions itself as a leading domestic enterprise in self-developed environmental monitoring instruments and systems, with competitive advantages in core technology innovation, quality control systems, and standardized operations.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: 2023 revenue was 350.04 million yuan (down 25.9% YoY), with net profit of 23.37 million yuan (down 59.96% YoY). Total assets reached 1,458.27 million yuan (up 94.57% YoY) and net assets 1,144.55 million yuan (up 130.88% YoY), primarily due to August 2023 IPO financing. The company achieved profitability with basic EPS of 0.36 yuan. Historical revenue peaked at 572.56 million yuan in 2021.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes: (1) comprehensive technical solutions spanning sensing, network, and application layers; (2) high-precision, modular, and integrated product design with strong reliability and maintainability; (3) extensive product portfolio covering 100+ monitoring factors; (4) advanced quality control systems and standardized service management; (5) integration of emerging technologies including AI, IoT, and big data analytics; (6) strong R&D capabilities with 93 research personnel and continuous innovation in core technologies.
